name: Verify user cancels during incident confirmation - no ticket created
objective: Validate that when a user cancels during the incident confirmation step, no incident is created.
precondition: User is logged in, on home page, AI Assistant panel is open. Assistant has gathered information and presents a summary.

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon and describe an issue to trigger incident creation flow
steps.testData: "My laptop is overheating and shutting down"
steps.expectedResult: The assistant gathers details and presents a summary

steps.description: When presented with the confirmation summary, cancel the creation
steps.testData: Click 'Cancel' or say "No, don't create it"

steps.expectedResult: No incident number or record link is shown

steps.description: Verify the assistant asks if further assistance is needed
steps.expectedResult: The assistant asks if the user needs help with anything else
